Advanced guidance: tool-guide:attempt_execute.

x-operator-guidance.example_identity_note: Replace objective-id with a submitted objective ID and choose outcomes from observed facts. Handles in examples illustrate returned handles; never invent them.

uncertainties.description: Only part of the response was inspected.

handles.attempts: Execution handles returned after dispatch; rejected submissions have none.
handles.observations: Inspected citation handles returned by observation_read, inside supported assessment items; no top-level observations.
handles.records: Historical record handles from accepted record_append only, never executions or artifacts.

x-operator-guidance.correction: Correct a rejected finish with a new call; do not replay completed target operations. Omit optional reporting collections when unnecessary.

oneOf.description: Finish; acceptance starts cleanup. Minimal: {"finish_reason":"no-useful-next-experiment","summary":"No tests ran.","objectives":[]}. attempts=execution handles; records=historical records only. uncertainties=[{"kind":"evidence-gap","description":"..."}]. No top-level observations. Correct without replay. artifact or unavailable_reason replaces inline fields. Runtime enforces identifier and content limits. Advanced guidance: tool-guide:finish.
Remove an injection using its returned injection handle; does not reverse committed mutations. Runtime enforces identifier and content limits. Advanced guidance: tool-guide:injection_delete.

x-operator-guidance.rules: Use the returned continuation verbatim. readable_observation remains readable, citation represents only verified inspected bytes. continuation is absent at EOF or when no readable bytes remain. A partial read never makes a whole-observation citation valid. Example handles must be replaced with actual returned handles.
